candidates.title: FlexPosit: Tunable Fractional Precision for LLM Inference Accelerators
candidates.reason: Hardware-oriented LLM inference work that exposes tunable fractional precision to trade quantization accuracy against accelerator scaling/control overhead, directly extending AWQ-era low-bit serving.

candidates.title: Scale-QLoRA: Code-Invariant Adapter Merging for Native 4-bit Microscaling LLMs
candidates.reason: Addresses deployment-time adapter merging on native 4-bit microscaling checkpoints while preserving discrete weight codes, directly relevant to quantized serving artifacts.

candidates.title: Unfolding the Leech Lattice: Fused Multi-Shell Decoding and VRAM Layouts for 2-Bit LLM Weights
candidates.reason: Provides a fused serving kernel and explicit VRAM layouts for a practical 2-bit LLM weight format, directly updating low-bit inference-kernel and memory-layout lineages.

candidates.title: E²LLM: Structure-Guided Efficient Inference for LLMs in Distributed Edge
candidates.reason: Targets asymmetric prefill/decode execution across constrained devices and edge nodes, directly connecting quantized efficient inference to heterogeneous distributed serving.

candidates.title: Budget-Aware LLM Quantization and Low-Rank Correction via Information-Guided Subspace Matrices
candidates.reason: Globally allocates mixed precision and low-rank correction under a fixed deployment memory budget, directly extending memory-constrained post-training quantization.
